entities.summary: Darius "Darjo" Earvin Johnson-Odom is an American professional basketball player for the Astros de Jalisco of the Mexican CIBACOPA. In 2009, he transferred to Marquette University from Hutchinson Community College. As a senior, Johnson-Odom was named first-team All-Big East.
